description.title: Computer Fraud Extension
description.summary: This table defines terms related to computer fraud coverage under an insurance policy. It details what constitutes 'Electronic Communication System', 'Electronic Data', and 'Electronic Data Processing Media' for the purposes of claim assessment.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית כוללת הרחבה לסייבר, המכסה נזקים כתוצאה מהונאה ממוחשבת. ההרחבה מגדירה 'מערכת תקשורת אלקטרונית' כפעולות תקשורת כמו Fedwire, CHIPS ו-SWIFT, ו'נתונים אלקטרוניים' כמידע המומר לפורמט שניתן לשימוש במערכת מחשב. לדוגמה, 'מערכת תקשורת אלקטרונית' כוללת את מערכת העברת הכספים של חיובים וזיכויים אוטומטיים.
description.row_axis: Definition of a term related to computer fraud
notable_values: Electronic Data: facts converted to a usable form
Electronic Data Processing Media: tapes, discs, or other bulk media

sketch:
PART III
COMPUTER FRAUD EXTENSION
Electronic Communication System means electronic communication operations by Fedwire, Clearing House Interbank Payment System (CHIPS), Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), Clearing House Automated Payment System (CHAPS), the funds transfer system of preauthorised recurring debits and credits of an Automated Clearing House Association  which  is  a  member  of  the  National  Automated  Clearing  House  Association  and similar automated communication systems.
Electronic Data means facts or information converted to a form usable in a Computer System which is stored on Electronic Data Processing Media for use by computer programs.
Electronic Data Processing Media means tapes, discs, or other bulk media, whether magnetic or optical, on which Electronic Data are recorded.

טבלה: Computer Fraud Extension
This table defines terms related to computer fraud coverage under an insurance policy. It details what constitutes 'Electronic Communication System', 'Electronic Data', and 'Electronic Data Processing Media' for the purposes of claim assessment.
ממדים: Definition of a term related to computer fraud, Term and its definition

PART III
COMPUTER FRAUD EXTENSION
Electronic Communication System means electronic communication operations by Fedwire, Clearing House Interbank Payment System (CHIPS), Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), Clearing House Automated Payment System (CHAPS), the funds transfer system of preauthorised recurring debits and credits of an Automated Clearing House Association  which  is  a  member  of  the  National  Automated  Clearing  House  Association  and similar automated communication systems.
Electronic Data means facts or information converted to a form usable in a Computer System which is stored on Electronic Data Processing Media for use by computer programs.
Electronic Data Processing Media means tapes, discs, or other bulk media, whether magnetic or optical, on which Electronic Data are recorded.
